about.title: El Cajon Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seven people died on El Cajon's roads in 2025, according to public collision records. Behind each of those numbers is a household in San Diego County that has to keep going without someone. Some of these losses happen on I-8, others along Broadway, E Main Street, or Fletcher Parkway, and many fall during the busy Friday stretch between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m. Wrongful death is not limited to traffic, though. A fatal fall at a property, a medical error, or a workplace incident can also give rise to a civil claim. California allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children to bring that claim first, with certain dependents and heirs following when there is no one in the first group. The clock runs two years from the date of death, and it can be shorter if a public agency is involved. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We simply put you in touch with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so you can decide at your own pace.

whyChoose.title: Why El Cajon Families Reach Out Through LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children. An attorney can tell you early whether you or another relative should bring the claim.

items.title: Deadlines handled before they slip
items.desc: Families generally have two years from the date of death, but a claim involving a city, county, or state agency carries a much shorter window. Getting connected soon keeps those options open.

items.title: A civil path separate from any criminal case
items.desc: Whether or not prosecutors in San Diego County file charges, a civil claim can seek funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of companionship and guidance. The two proceedings run on their own tracks.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on I-8 near El Cajon. Does the government's involvement change anything?
items.answer: It can. If a Caltrans design issue, a city vehicle, or another public entity is part of the picture, California requires a government claim to be filed within months rather than years. An attorney can look at where and how the collision happened and identify whether that shorter deadline applies. It is one of the reasons families in El Cajon are encouraged not to wait.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves independently of any criminal prosecution. The criminal case is about penalties for the driver; the civil case is about losses your family has suffered. Many attorneys begin gathering evidence while the criminal matter is still pending.

items.question: What losses can a wrongful death claim actually cover in California?
items.answer: California recognizes both financial and personal losses. That includes funeral and burial expenses, the income and support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. No one can promise a particular result, but an attorney can explain how each category is documented in a case like yours.
